mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months (measured by the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past three months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a given month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 return over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 tends to underperform by more than 1.5% over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (measured by the 3-month change in PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases by more than 50,000 jobs over the past three months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals rising inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 0.3pp from previous month) indicates a severe economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods where HOUST declines and UNRATE rises by more than 0.3 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%), the S&P 500 tends to outperform by more than 1.0% over the next 20 trading days due to accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.
